sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of 'Tommy and the Fire' lies its core gameplay mechanics. The game is all about speed and survival, where you control Tommy as he runs towards the finish line. The twist is that a deadly blade is hot on his heels, and you need to avoid it at all costs. The controls are simple, with the option to use mouse, keyboard, or touch controls. This makes it easy to pick up and play, even for those who are new to gaming.

The gameplay is straightforward, with the goal of reaching the finish line without getting caught by the blade. However, as you progress through the levels, the blade gets faster and closer, making it increasingly difficult to avoid. This adds an element of challenge and excitement to the game, making it a thrilling experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

One of the unique features of 'Tommy and the Fire' is its use of sound effects and music to enhance the gameplay experience.
